description: This header file provides internal helper functions and constants for the Starboard Accessibility API, including color matching, font size, and opacity calculations, as well as color definitions.

methods.name: GetClosestCaptionColorRGB
methods.description: Returns the closest caption color enum based on RGB input by calculating the minimal color distance.

methods.name: GetClosestCaptionColor
methods.description: Converts an RGB color integer to the closest caption color enum.

methods.name: FindClosestReferenceValue
methods.description: Finds the reference value closest to the given value from an array of reference values.

methods.name: GetClosestFontSizePercentage
methods.description: Returns the closest font size percentage enum based on input font size percentage.

methods.name: GetClosestOpacity
methods.description: Returns the closest opacity percentage enum based on input opacity percentage.
